capabilities: Highlight due dates with color warnings
disambiguation: It manages todo.txt plain-text files, not Obsidian Markdown task checkboxes.
extras: Two features (preserving priorities on complete, recurring tasks) are experimental and must be enabled in settings; further documentation of recurring tasks is linked elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open and edit todo.txt files as task lists.

relations.evidence: The TodoTxt Plugin supports some extensions to the basic todo.txt spec
Thanks to the authors of SwiftoDo for documenting the due and recurring extensions to the spec

summary: View and manage Todo.txt task files inside Obsidian with due dates, thresholds, priorities and recurring tasks.
